entities.summary: Beka Lomtadze is a Georgian freestyle wrestler competing in the 61 kg division. Lomtadze began wrestling at the age of 13 in his home country of Georgia. He won gold medal in 2019 world championships in Nur-Sultan and silver 2016 world championships in Budapest.
